decisions.reason: The quoted sentence directly states that 'treatment was associated with objective reduction in seizures (determined by electroencephalography and parental reporting).' The quote is present in the abstract, explicitly describes milasen treatment reducing seizures with objective measurement methods, and clearly supports the therapeutic_effect relationship between milasen (treatment) and seizures (phenotype). The evidence type 'observed' is appropriate because the abstract presents this as an empirical finding from the N-of-1 study.
